bullets.text: Security-First Culture Needed - **Microsoft** emphasizes a security-first approach as AI adoption accelerates.
Transparent Email Security Insights - **Microsoft** releases a benchmarking report to enhance email security performance understanding.
Windows 11 Insider Build Released - New features and improvements are introduced in the latest **Windows 11** Insider Preview.
Gaming Innovations in 2025 - **Microsoft** enhances Windows gaming with new handheld devices and DirectX advancements.
AI Modernizer for Developers - **Microsoft** introduces a tool to simplify JavaScript/TypeScript project updates in VS Code.
Faster Web Apps Proposed - **Microsoft** suggests a new API to improve performance in complex web applications.
Cloud Infrastructure Expansion - **Microsoft** announces new datacenter regions to meet growing cloud demand in the US.
Supply Chain Attack Guidance - **Microsoft** details defense strategies against the Shai-Hulud 2.0 supply chain attack.
Evolving Cyber Defense Strategies - **Microsoft** discusses innovative approaches to enhance cyber defense mechanisms.
Node.js on Azure Functions - **Microsoft** simplifies hosting Node.js MCP servers with Azure Functions.
